newsitem.title: USA: Prime Cellular buys Bern for fewer shrs.
newsitem.headline: Prime Cellular buys Bern for fewer shrs.

text.p: Prime Cellular Inc said on Tuesday it agreed to reduce the number of shares issued in connection with the previously consummated acquisition of Bern Associates Inc, to 1.025 million Prime Cellular shares from 4.1 million.

Prime Cellular said the agreement was reached with owners holding about 80 percent of the shares to be received in the acquisition and it intended to pursue its claims against the individuals owning the other roughly 20 percent.
The agreement was entered into in consideration for the release by Prime Cellular of certain claims of breaches and representations and warranties, the company said.

The company also said four employee shareholders of Bern Communications, the new name of Bern Associates, have also agreed to reduce their compensation to $95,000 per year and to extend the terms to their agreement.
The Bern merger was consummated on June 11.
These people were also granted three year options to buy 256,250 shares of Prime Cellular common stock at an exercise price of $8 per share, the company said.
